 David Muir 
 David Muir's biggest successes this year as he celebrates his 53rd birthday
 Comments Entertainment Maria Letícia Gomes GAU Writer 05:00 ET, 08 Nov 2026 Redwood National Park coverage
 View 9 Images 8 of 9 Another highlight from his Disney Celebrates America special was his journey to Redwood National and State Parks in Northern California to profile them as one of the "7 Wonders of America." David reported on high-priority subjects such as environmental resilience, conservation, and indigenous land stewardship, but a viral moment emerged from the coverage. While he was conducting an on-camera interview on the ancestral land of the Yurok Tribe, an elk emerged from the woods and approached the group, creating a wholesome, deeply moving moment for the entire crew - a moment his fans celebrated on social media. (Image: davidmuirabc/Instagram) 
 Trip to Beijing
 View 9 Images 9 of 9 Back in May, he anchored live from Beijing during a high-stakes bilateral summit between U.S. President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping, covering critical diplomatic maneuvering, including trade relations, energy imports involving mutual allies like Iran, and regional security frameworks. There, David produced a viral, multi-part segment exploring how China is pushing the boundaries of the global artificial intelligence and robotics race, and went viral yet again for his encounter with a 5-foot-5-inch, 121-pound humanoid robot named "Oli" developed by Limx Dynamics. After witnessing the robot's dexterity - with feats including moving on rollerblades and ice skates - he jokingly noted, "I was mesmerized early on, but now I'm terrified." (Image: davidmuirabc/Instagram)
